description: This file contains service functions for managing recipe data, including creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting recipes. It interacts with SQLAlchemy ORM models and the database session, providing a business logic layer for recipe-related operations.

methods.name: _apply_recipe_relations(stmt)
methods.description: Utility function for eager-loading the category and tags relations of recipes to optimize database queries.

methods.name: Recipe create_recipe( db: Session, *, author_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str], instructions: str, ingredients: str, category_id: Optional[int], tag_ids: List[int], )
methods.description: Creates a new recipe record with provided details and attaches tags if specified.

methods.name: Optional[Recipe] get_recipe(db: Session, recipe_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a single recipe by ID, including related category and tags, if available.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Recipe],int] list_recipes(db: Session, *, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of recipes along with the total count, including related category and tags.

methods.name: Recipe update_recipe( db: Session, *, recipe: Recipe, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, instructions: Optional[str] = None, ingredients: Optional[str] = None, category_id: Optional[int] = None, tag_ids: Optional[List[int]] = None, )
methods.description: Updates a given recipe's fields and associated tags, if provided.

methods.name: None delete_recipe(db: Session, *, recipe: Recipe)
methods.description: Deletes the specified recipe from the database.
